notes.title: Add a Power System! Greatly enhance playability and replayability.
notes.content:
The previous version had poor playability, making players feel bored while playing. Some netizens suggested referencing Nintendo's badge claw machine, and I also referred to it and made some modifications. Since I haven't played it myself and only watched videos, I tried to imitate it roughly, so there might be some discrepancies. I hope everyone will be satisfied.  

Regarding playability and sustainability, I added a "Power" system, which is the one in the lower right corner of the picture. Using power allows players to unlock skins and purchase items. Each coin insertion grants 1 power, and catching a doll awards an additional 5 power. The battery has corresponding power animations to try to give players a sense of satisfaction and achievement when obtaining power.

notes.title: Add the swing of the hook and fix the bug.

notes.title: Fix the bug and add the claw-swinging function.
notes.content:
- [x] Added a claw-swinging operation. Pressing the claw hook three times in a left-right cycle will make it glow and significantly increase the chance of grabbing.
- [x] Added physical collision effects for the claw.
- [x] Fixed the bug where dolls would fall out of the claw machine.
- [x] Fixed the issue where small dolls would get stuck on the claw.
- [x] The claw now pauses for 0.1 seconds at the bottom before grabbing.

notes.title: Regarding the Update Plan of Doll Catching Simulator
notes.content:
Since the architecture of this project has been basically finalized, I can only make some updates. The main purpose of the update is to add positive feedback to the game, enhance playability and the length of gameplay. The following updates are just plans and may not be implemented. If you have any suggestions, you can write them in the comment section.

- Add the operation of swinging the claw. Press the claw left and right in a cycle. After pressing it three times, the claw will glow and significantly increase the chance of grabbing.
- Refer to Nintendo's badge claw machine and add a bomb claw. When the bomb is dropped, it can blow up the dolls.
- Add a hammer claw that can hammer the dolls towards the exit direction.
- Add a "power" value system. If the grab fails, +1 part will be obtained, and if the grab is successful, +5 parts will be obtained. Only when the power reaches a certain level can new claws and skins be unlocked. The power value will be displayed on the screen in real time.
- All the current skins of the claw machines will be changed to the same default skin, and the skins can only be unlocked by using the "power" value.
- Add background music.
